nom: Dr. Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule

avis.texte: great product. used one and noticed a difference right away! I have very sensitive skin for reference, it gently exfoliated my face and made it SO soft while also brightening and leaving a glowy finish but not so much that I felt greasy. I will definitely be buying again.

avis.titre: Helps with oily skin and sebaceous hyperplasia
avis.texte: I am completely oblivious to hype around this product, I saw it in an email from Ulta just saying it was a new thing, and I like K-beauty. So I looked up how to use it, and at the time I had just been fighting with my oily skin, which has changed as I near 40. The old days of oily skin mostly affecting makeup longevity have passed and now I am in the era of glycolic acid and battling hormonal acne of a different kind. I use the white rice on my forehead and cheeks where i have had small white bumps lingering after acne for many months (one of which was removed by a dermatologist who diagnosed me with SH, but I can't afford to go back and need to focus on prevention). The change was not immediate overnight, but I suffered no bad reactions to the first use and did it again a couple of times throughout the following week, and I can tell the older white bumps are going down when they were not being affected by anything else. I use the black rice on my nose and chin where double cleansing hadn't managed all the blackheads and it has definitely improved there as well. But I am reviewing this one primarily because very few things have helped my skin from this issue in a meaningful way and I hope it helps someone else.

I saw all the social media posts and I got sucked in. Did it cleam my deep pores. Yes. As good as on the videos you saw… no. But it did a good general exfoliation. It is drying. Be prepared to moisturize.

Much like another review, my first initial thought was, witchcraft. I cannot believe how well it works while still being gentle. I was scared to upset my eczema but my skin is so hydrated after. I have never felt or seen my skin be this radiant before and the results were almost immediate. I'm ready to dump literally all my products in the trash for Dr. Melaxin.

What is this witchcraft?! I used this on my face and my face felt so exfoliated, definitely a difference after one use. I even used it on a chronic stubborn dry spot on my wrist and it sloughed off. This stuff is crazy. I used some hyalauronic acid after and some cerave lotion and my face feels crazy good/ smooth. Some of it might be product but I feel like some dead skin for sure came off.

Ive used Peel Shot for approximately 6 months, & it has dramatically changed my skin for the better. My face used to be so dry, it seemed no exfoliator really helped. Within a couple weeks of using the Peel Shot regularly, I was so pleased with my skin. I use it daily after my cleanser, and at 45, i can confidently say i have never been happier with my skin. My complexion is even, I've not had any dry spots since i began using, & I have a glowing complexion now! To those who think its a gimmick, I suggest trying it once, rinse & repeat once more or even two more times back to back. You will know it's actual skin cells because the 2nd time, there will be minimal little balls of exfoliated skin. Rinse & repeat again & there will be none- nothing else would do that except skin cells. My skin has NEVER looked better, healthier or had this glass skin glow! Try for yourself & be amazed!
